name: GREATEC
recent: Greatech 于 2026 年 11 月 24 日宣布，其全资子公司 Greatech Integration (M) Sdn Bhd 拟以 RM153mil 收购位于 Bayan Lepas 的两处工业物业。同日，公司公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，并披露订单簿为 RM1.98bil。此外，EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间持续申报其作为大股东的持股变动。
notable: 全资子公司拟以 RM153mil 收购槟城 Bayan Lepas 两处工业物业。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，并披露订单簿为 RM1.98bil。
EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报大股东持股变动。
risks: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间持续申报持股变动，需留意其持股比例变化。
earnings: 最新财报（2026-06-30）显示，营收为 MYR209.603mil，环比增长 17.1%，但同比下降 9.9%；净利为 MYR33.576mil，环比增长 24.8%，同比增长 29.5%；净利率为 16.0%，高于上一期的 15.0%。

recent_en: On 24 Nov 2026, Greatech announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary Greatech Integration (M) Sdn Bhd proposed to acquire two industrial properties in Bayan Lepas for RM153mil. On the same day, the company reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026 and disclosed an order book of RM1.98bil. In addition, EPF continued to file changes in its substantial shareholder interest throughout October and November.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary proposed to acquire two industrial properties in Bayan Lepas, Penang, for RM153mil.
Reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026 and disclosed an order book of RM1.98bil.
EPF filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interest during October and November.
risks_en: EPF continued to file changes in shareholding during October and November; its shareholding level should be monitored.
earnings_en: The latest financials (2026-06-30) show revenue of MYR209.603mil, up 17.1% QoQ but down 9.9% YoY; net income was MYR33.576mil, up 24.8% QoQ and 29.5% YoY; net margin was 16.0%, higher than 15.0% in the prior period.
